# Zone: App Blocker & Focus

> Zone is an iPhone and iPad focus timer that blocks selected apps and websites during timed sessions.

Official website: https://zonefocus.app
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6763581982
Developer: Vikas Saini
Platforms: iPhone and iPad, iOS/iPadOS 18 or later

## Official pages
- https://zonefocus.app/
- https://zonefocus.app/app-blocker/
- https://zonefocus.app/screen-time-alternative/
- https://zonefocus.app/stop-doomscrolling-iphone/
- https://zonefocus.app/faq/
- https://zonefocus.app/privacy/
- https://zonefocus.app/press/

## Core facts
- Zone combines a focus timer with app and website blocking.
- Strict Mode can make a running session harder to abandon.
- No account is required.
- Zone cannot see the specific apps or websites selected for blocking.
- Zone supports Live Activities, Dynamic Island, focus insights, streaks, and optional Apple Health Mindful Minutes.
- Zone is a productivity tool, not medical treatment.
